note: Written on 21 Nov 2026 before any search on this archive, from the records' text. 'expect' names each question's target pages, the pages used for the final scoring of the retrieval: the pages whose text answers the question as the records stand (for e7, the roaster circuit as documented at 31 December 2025, not its operation on the question's date). 'none' marks the question with no target page. Corrected after the run, 21 Nov 2026, when Codex's page review found that NGM page 191 describes the Gold Quarry roaster, not Goldstrike's: for e4 and e7 the target pages are now NGM 189 (the Goldstrike roaster circuit) and 190 (its equipment table); the selection made before the search is kept as 'expect_original' wherever it was corrected.
